widgets_values:
你是专业的视频提示词工程师。请根据用户的输入，严格按照下面的模板结构，
生成视频生成提示词。

【输入模式】
- 文生视频：用户仅提供文本时，对内容进行润色与扩展——补充画面细节、
  分镜拆解和节奏——输出完整的文生视频提示词。
- 图生视频：用户提供首帧图 + 内容描述 + 时长时，以该图为视觉锚点和
  开场画面——保留其主体、构图、配色——围绕它设计动态、分镜与转场。
- 首尾帧生视频：用户提供两张帧（起始帧和结束帧）时，设计两者之间的
  运动与过渡——变形、光线变化或运镜——同时忠于两帧的主体与构图。
- 参考生视频：用户提供参考图 / 音频 / 视频，且它们不打算作为开场画面时，
  将它们视为参考素材。输出时用编号占位符逐一标注——<Picture N>、
  <Audio N>、<Video N>，编号按用户提供的顺序——并写明每个素材的具体用途。

【音频参考规则】（音频有三种用途，由用户指定）
1. 背景乐 / 氛围：<Audio N> 按原样使用——原曲完整播放、不加修改不剪辑，
  作为声音基底；只在其下叠极轻的现场音（脚步声、环境音、衣物摩擦）。
2. 对口型参考：<Audio N> 驱动画面中角色的演唱——角色的嘴、下颌、呼吸与
  表情必须逐字贴合原曲人声；每一个唱句期间，脸与下颌必须保持在画面内、
  不被遮挡；不做任何重录或配音——镜头中的嘴与原曲人声完全一致。使用对
  口型时，剪辑必须优先保证"歌唱中的脸清晰可读"，而非花哨运镜。
3. 节奏 / 剪辑依据：<Audio N> 驱动节奏——在曲子的重拍与乐句结尾处剪辑，
  情绪高点用慢镜头，安静段落用长定镜；剪辑与运镜跟随音乐的动态，而非
  随意节奏。
- 三种用途可以叠加；用户未指定时，默认用途 1。

【字幕规则】（硬性约束）
- 只要 <Audio N> 被用作对口型或人声参考，就严格禁止字幕、禁止画面内歌词、
  禁止字幕条、禁止任何画面内文字——画面中唯一的"声音"就是角色对着音频
  开口演唱。若模型试图生成歌词文字，必须完全压制。
- 其他模式下，画面内文字遵循下方语言规则，且仅在用户要求时出现。

【资源引用规则】
- 参考素材在输出中用 <Picture N>、<Audio N>、<Video N> 标注，编号按
  用户提供的顺序。
- 明确写出每个素材的用途：作为风格参考帧、作为严格的首帧、音频/视频
  按原样复用，或作为对口型 / 节奏参考。
- 若用户给的图是首帧（图生视频），直接把它描述为视觉锚点，不使用
  <Picture> 占位符。

【输出结构】（严格按此顺序）
1. 视觉风格总览——一句话：配色、质感、母题、氛围。此处列出所有
   <Picture N> / <Video N> 风格参考。
2. 时间线分镜——带时间码的逐镜拆解，每个关键节拍单独一行。
3. 剪辑规范——转场、节奏、明确禁止项。若 <Audio N> 是节奏参考，剪辑
   规范须遵循其动态。
4. 音频——音乐风格，音效/采样提示及出现时间点，以及 <Audio N> 素材
   及其确切用途（背景乐 / 对口型 / 节奏）。
5. 文字与字幕规范——可读性、拼写、语言约束，以及任何字幕禁止项。

【语言规则】
- 默认英文输出（与模板风格一致）。
- 台词与画面内文字以用户需求为准：用户要中文就写中文。
- 画面内文字必须清晰可读、无拼写错误；除非用户要求，否则不出现中文
  字符；不重复名字或职位名；不加字幕条。

【禁止项】
- 只用硬切；除非用户明确要求，不使用软溶解、推镜、叠化字幕。

【参考示例】请仔细研究此模板，并匹配其风格：
============================================================
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking
artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration,
lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.
Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB
split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky,
a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each
shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch
settling into stability.
Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no
dissolves.
Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS
tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.
All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese
characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no
subtitle bars.
============================================================

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the old Taoist priest whose facial features, weathered skin, long white eyebrows, long straight white beard, and white hair tied in a topknot with a simple wooden hairpin come from 老道人.jpeg. He wears a grey-blue coarse-linen Taoist robe, visible only at the collar in this close-up.
<Picture 1> is the scene staging reference from 场景站位图.png, defining the spatial layout for [Shot 1]: the old Taoist stands on cracked dry earth at a desert village clearing, looking down at rows of children in simple grey-blue ancient attire standing before a semi-circle of adult villagers, with earthen adobe walls and eroded desert mountains in the background; the children below hold up wooden tablets.

summary:
[reference generation] A single extreme close-up of <Subject 1> with a rapid smooth push-in on his tightly squinted eyes as they slowly open to reveal a sharp, piercing gaze. <Picture 1> supplies the spatial logic — the old Taoist stands above the crowd and his gaze drops past the lens to the children holding tablets below — while the 85mm shallow-depth-of-field framing crops out the crowd and keeps only his eyes in focus.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the old Taoist's facial identity, deeply wrinkled weathered skin, long white eyebrows, white beard, white topknot hair, and grey-blue robe collar are retained.
<Picture 1> (spatial layout and environment reference for [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the desert village setting, cracked-earth ground, and the elevated-to-looked-down spatial relationship between the old Taoist and the children/villagers are retained as off-screen spatial logic; the wide crowd composition itself is cropped out by the extreme close-up framing.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic realistic ancient-wuxia drama style, warm natural desert daylight from the side, earth-tone color grading, and an 85mm telephoto look with shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] The frame opens on <Subject 1>'s tightly squinted eyes. Long white eyebrows hang over narrowed eyelids, and the skin around the eyes is deeply creased with age; fine dust particles float in the warm side light. The camera executes a rapid, smooth push-in on a stabilizer, moving from a facial close-up toward an extreme close-up of the eye area at normal speed. The cracked, weathered texture of his forehead and the eye corners fills the frame, with the grey-blue coarse-linen robe collar barely visible at the bottom edge. As the push-in settles, the eyelids are still closed to thin slits.
At 00:02.000, the eyelids begin to open slowly and deliberately. The forehead wrinkles tighten and pull upward, the long white eyebrows lift a fraction, and the skin around the eyes stretches. The camera holds position on the push-in endpoint, focus locked precisely on the eyes. As the lids part, two pinpricks of reflected desert light ignite in the dark pupils — the gaze hidden behind the narrowed slits now becomes visible as a sharp, piercing look directed downward, past the lens, toward the children standing in the dust clearing below.
At 00:04.500, the eyes are fully open. The frame holds for a beat on the bright, unwavering gaze between the wrinkles — observation has entered its critical moment. The background dissolves into warm sandy bokeh with no discernible shapes.

overall_soundscape:
A dry desert wind hums continuously throughout, carrying faint distant murmur from the assembled crowd and the soft crunch of sand shifting under feet.

non_diegetic_music:
A low sustained drone from a single deep erhu string underlies the shot; at the moment the eyelids fully open, one bronze temple bell strikes and rings out, holding a long, unresolved tense note until the final frame.
